title: Leading run of a unary block
statement: For every $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and every finite Boolean string $r$, removing the longest initial run of $1$s from $1^{k+1}0r$ returns run length $k+1$ and remainder $0r$.
replaced:
For every $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and every bit string $r$, splitting the bit string
$1^{k+1}\,0\,r$ into its maximal leading run of $1$s and the remainder gives the run length
$k+1$ and the remainder $0\,r$.
